mapper.sql: select r.resource_id, r.title, r.category_id, c.category_name, r.res_type, r.file_id, r.file_name, r.file_size, r.file_ext, r.external_url, r.duration, r.cover, r.visible_scope, r.allow_download, r.ref_count, r.status, r.owner_id, u.nick_name as owner_name, r.create_time, r.update_time from edu_resource r left join edu_resource_category c on c.category_id = r.category_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = r.owner_id
mapper.insert: insert into edu_resource (title, category_id, res_type, file_id, file_name, file_size, file_ext, external_url, duration, cover, visible_scope, allow_download, ref_count, status, owner_id, del_flag, create_time) values (#{title}, #{categoryId}, #{resType}, #{fileId}, #{fileName}, #{fileSize}, #{fileExt}, #{externalUrl}, #{duration}, #{cover}, #{visibleScope}, #{allowDownload}, 0, #{status}, #{ownerId}, '0', sysdate())
mapper.update: update edu_resource set del_flag = '2', update_time = sysdate() where resource_id = #{resourceId}
update edu_resource r set r.ref_count = (select count(1) from edu_task_resource tr where tr.resource_id = r.resource_id), r.update_time = sysdate() where r.resource_id = #{resourceId}
mapper.select: select course_id from edu_course_resource where resource_id = #{resourceId} order by id
mapper.insert: insert into edu_course_resource (course_id, resource_id, sort_no) values (#{courseId}, #{resourceId}, #{sortNo})
mapper.delete: delete from edu_course_resource where course_id = #{courseId} and resource_id = #{resourceId}
mapper.select: select r.resource_id, r.title, r.category_id, c.category_name, r.res_type, r.file_id, r.file_name, r.file_size, r.file_ext, r.external_url, r.duration, r.cover, r.visible_scope, r.allow_download, r.ref_count, r.status, r.owner_id, u.nick_name as owner_name, r.create_time from edu_course_resource cr join edu_resource r on r.resource_id = cr.resource_id and r.del_flag = '0' left join edu_resource_category c on c.category_id = r.category_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = r.owner_id where cr.course_id = #{courseId} order by cr.sort_no, cr.id

select c.category_id, c.parent_id, c.category_name, c.order_num, c.owner_id, c.status, (select count(1) from edu_resource r where r.category_id = c.category_id and r.del_flag = '0') as resource_count from edu_resource_category c
and c.parent_id = #{parentId} and c.status = #{status}
and c.category_name like concat('%', #{categoryName}, '%')
order by c.parent_id, c.order_num, c.category_id
select category_id, parent_id, category_name, order_num, owner_id, status from edu_resource_category where category_id = #{categoryId}
mapper.insert: insert into edu_resource_category (parent_id, category_name, order_num, owner_id, status) values (#{parentId}, #{categoryName}, #{orderNum}, #{ownerId}, #{status})
mapper.select: select count(1) from edu_resource_category where parent_id = #{categoryId}
select count(1) from edu_resource where category_id = #{categoryId} and del_flag = '0'
